items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Contract-native button group — parts from contract/anatomy/button-group.json, recipe on contract slots only. Grouping container — role=group with an accessible name; each child keeps its own button semantics and its own tab stop. A roving-tabindex toolbar.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Contract-native calendar — parts from contract/anatomy/calendar.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG grid pattern as used by the Date Picker Dialog: the month is a role=grid of week rows and day gridcells, with a roving tabindex so exactly one day is tabbable. Arrow keys move by day and by week, Home/End go to the start/end of the week, PageUp/PageDown change month.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Contract-native card — parts from contract/anatomy/card.json, recipe on contract slots only. Static grouping container; no APG pattern.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Contract-native carousel — parts from contract/anatomy/carousel.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG carousel pattern: the root is a region with aria-roledescription='carousel' and an accessible name; each slide is role=group with aria-roledescription='slide' and an 'N of M' label. Previous/next are real buttons, disabled.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Contract-native chart — parts from contract/anatomy/chart.json, recipe on contract slots only. None — the plot itself is a graphic. Accessibility comes from a text alternative, not from the drawing: the root is role=img with an accessible name and description, and the same data is exposed as a visually-hidden table so keyboard and screen-reader users get the values. Interactive tooltips follow the APG tooltip pattern.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Contract-native checkbox — parts from contract/anatomy/checkbox.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG checkbox pattern.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Contract-native collapsible — parts from contract/anatomy/collapsible.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG disclosure pattern.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Contract-native command — parts from contract/anatomy/command.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG combobox pattern with a listbox popup, hosted in an APG dialog.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Contract-native context menu — parts from contract/anatomy/context-menu.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG menu pattern invoked by context action.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Contract-native dialog — parts from contract/anatomy/dialog.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG dialog.

items.title: Drawer

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Contract-native dropdown menu — parts from contract/anatomy/dropdown-menu.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG menu button pattern.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Contract-native empty — parts from contract/anatomy/empty.json, recipe on contract slots only. None — presentational empty-state container; no APG pattern. The title is a real heading so the region is reachable by heading navigation, and any recovery affordance keeps its own button/link semantics. When the emptiness is the result of a completed load, the host region announces it.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Contract-native field — parts from contract/anatomy/field.json, recipe on contract slots only. None — composition wrapper; native labeling semantics.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Contract-native form — parts from contract/anatomy/form.json, recipe on contract slots only. None — native <form> semantics. APG form/validation guidance: every control has an accessible name from its label.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Contract-native hover card — parts from contract/anatomy/hover-card.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG tooltip pattern widened to a non-modal preview disclosure.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Contract-native icon — parts from contract/anatomy/icon.json, recipe on contract slots only. presentational.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Contract-native input — parts from contract/anatomy/input.json, recipe on contract slots only. None — native <input> semantics.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Contract-native input group — parts from contract/anatomy/input-group.json, recipe on contract slots only. None — role=group wrapping one native control plus adornments. The group is never focusable: focus lands on the hosted control and the group reflects it.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input Otp
items.description: Contract-native input otp — parts from contract/anatomy/input-otp.json, recipe on contract slots only. Native text-input semantics on a single visually segmented field. ONE control owns the value, the focus and the tab stop.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Contract-native item — parts from contract/anatomy/item.json, recipe on contract slots only. None of its own — a content-row primitive. Inside a group the wrapper takes role=list and each item role=listitem; an interactive item adopts the semantics of the element it renders as.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Contract-native kbd — parts from contract/anatomy/kbd.json, recipe on contract slots only. None — presentational. Renders the native <kbd> element so assistive tech announces the content as keyboard input; never focusable, never interactive, and pointer-inert so it cannot swallow clicks on the surface hosting it..

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Contract-native label — parts from contract/anatomy/label.json, recipe on contract slots only. None — native <label> semantics.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Contract-native menubar — parts from contract/anatomy/menubar.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG menubar pattern.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: Contract-native native select — parts from contract/anatomy/native-select.json, recipe on contract slots only. None beyond the platform's own — a native <select>. The user agent supplies the listbox behaviour.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Contract-native navigation menu — parts from contract/anatomy/navigation-menu.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG disclosure-navigation pattern inside a nav landmark.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Contract-native pagination — parts from contract/anatomy/pagination.json, recipe on contract slots only. A navigation landmark: <nav> with an accessible name.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Contract-native popover — parts from contract/anatomy/popover.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG disclosure / non-modal dialog pattern.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Contract-native progress — parts from contract/anatomy/progress.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG meter/progressbar pattern.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Contract-native radio group — parts from contract/anatomy/radio-group.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG radio group pattern.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Contract-native scroll area — parts from contract/anatomy/scroll-area.json, recipe on contract slots only. None — a native scroll container with custom-drawn scrollbars. The viewport must stay keyboard-scrollable: it receives tabindex=0.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Contract-native select — parts from contract/anatomy/select.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG combobox/listbox pattern.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Contract-native separator — parts from contract/anatomy/separator.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG separator pattern.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Contract-native sheet — parts from contract/anatomy/sheet.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG dialog.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Contract-native sidebar — parts from contract/anatomy/sidebar.json, recipe on contract slots only. A navigation landmark.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Contract-native skeleton — parts from contract/anatomy/skeleton.json, recipe on contract slots only. None — presentational placeholder. The placeholder itself is aria-hidden and the region it stands in for carries aria-busy=true, so assistive tech announces one loading status instead of reading a wall of empty shapes. It is never focusable and must not shift layout when the real content arrives..

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Contract-native slider — parts from contract/anatomy/slider.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG slider pattern: each thumb is role=slider with aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Contract-native sonner — parts from contract/anatomy/sonner.json, recipe on contract slots only. APG alert/status host — the notification region, not the notification. An aria-live region.

items.name: spinner
